column1: # survey_response_map.tsv — which production row each field-survey response describes.
# Derived 5 September 2026 from the Shrine Information Form (Responses) sheet,
# 1zf7byAFp2Uf-LXNh2_wL3zazfZsuaUKn2t7Lr9S2oWw, single tab gid=1290048597, read as CSV via
# .../export?format=csv (not the Drive reader, which escapes underscores and can cut long cells).
# Why this file exists: the mapping is not mechanical. Nine of the nineteen live responses name
# their shrine differently from the sheet — "Darbar Sufi Aziz ul Deen Peer Makki Sarkar" is
# Meera Mouj Darya Bhukari" is `shrine-of-mauj-darya-bukhari` — and token-overlap matching gets
# four of them wrong, including sending "Darbar Modho Laal Hussain" to Data Darbar. It was done by
# hand, and until 5 September it had been done by hand at least three times without being written
# `shrine_id` on a Delete row is the shrine its superseded draft describes, carried from the live
# row of the same name; it is not a claim that the draft was ever published.
# **When a new response arrives, add its row here by hand and check the id.** The gate cannot
# tell the difference between a response nobody has mapped and a response that does not exist.
# Supersedes pipeline/legacy-exports/survey_canonical.tsv, which covered 14 of the 28 and carried
